name: AGF Management Limited
summary: AGF Management Limited is employee owned investment manager. The firm provides its services to financial advisors, high-net worth and institutional investors including pension plans, corporate plans, sovereign wealth funds, endowments and foundations. The firm manages separate client focused portfolios. AGF's products and services include a diversified family of more than 50 mutual funds, the evolutionary AGF Elements portfolios, the Harmony asset management program, AGF Private Investment Management, Institutional Account Services and AGF Trust GICs, loans and mortgages.
